title: Tool Error Rate
description: Query strings below are plain-English-adjacent pseudo-SQL, not copy-paste-ready syntax for any specific Grafana datasource plugin — no real backend/datasource is wired up in this build. Source: obs.v1 tool.post events in ~/.claude/metrics/events/*.ndjson, emitted by payload/hooks/obs-events.sh's PostToolUse handler (Phase 1). Charts attrs.ok (false when the tool_response carried isError) and attrs.error_class (the tool_response's error field, only set when attrs.ok is false).

panels.title: Overall tool error rate
panels.description: Source: obs.v1 tool.post events' attrs.ok. Fraction of tool.post events with attrs.ok = false.

targets.query: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE attrs.ok = false) * 1.0 / count(*) AS error_rate FROM obs_events WHERE event = 'tool.post'

panels.title: Errors by error_class and tool_name
panels.description: Source: obs.v1 tool.post events' attrs.error_class grouped with attrs.tool_name, restricted to attrs.ok = false rows.

targets.query: SELECT attrs.tool_name, attrs.error_class, count(*) FROM obs_events WHERE event = 'tool.post' AND attrs.ok = false GROUP BY attrs.tool_name, attrs.error_class ORDER BY count(*) DESC
